method.notes: Representative buried-unsatisfied-polar literature; not the exact software used

representative_paper.title: Protein sequence optimization with a pairwise decomposable penalty for buried unsatisfied hydrogen bonds

burial.sasa_engine: Bio.PDB ShrakeRupley on original PDB (not PQR)

polar_groups.donors: backbone N-H; side-chain N-H / O-H of ASN,GLN,ARG,LYS,HIS,TRP,SER,THR,TYR when H present in PQR
polar_groups.acceptors: backbone O; side-chain O/N acceptors of ASP,GLU,ASN,GLN,SER,THR,TYR,HIS

unsatisfied_definition: buried residue polar heavy atom (donor or acceptor) with no qualifying H-bond partner

round1_distinction.round1_proxy: buried polar/charged residue with zero N/O heavy atoms within 3.5A of CA from neighbors within 6A — no explicit H geometry
round1_distinction.this_family: pdb2pqr hydrogens + D–A distance + D–H–A angle on polar heavy atoms
